text:
Your face in your hair

is the pheasant in the nest;

Eros caught in the light net

of the first smile,

held still.


It is Astarte's ill-omened face

above her thighs of gold,

fearsome fruit-and magician!-

among the branches of a vague

sycamore.


It is moon in the groves

and spark upon the forge,

and, with its trembling of silks,

a handful of coins

in the water.

translation.title: Your Face in Your Hair...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the luxuriant sequence of face, Eros, Astarte, moon, forge, silk, and water.
